success_definition.statement: Define what a successful, sustainable outcome means for this project.

intended_readers: Describe the primary reader group without stereotyping it.
audience_and_positioning.reader_need: Describe the experience or value promised to the reader.
genre_demographic_format_promises: State one promise the work intends to fulfill.

creative_execution.one_line_logline: Write a one-line premise with protagonist, disruption, stakes, and distinction.

protagonist_drive.stakes: State what changes if the protagonist fails.

early_hook.question_or_disruption: State the early compelling question or disruption.
early_hook.payoff_signal: State how readers will know the opening promise is progressing.

escalation_and_reset: State how pressure grows and where breathing room belongs.

movement_requirements: State what must change within each unit.
ending_beats: State the intended ending pressure or emotional turn.

readability_checks: A first-time reader can identify event order and the dominant action.
repeatable_identity: State a repeatable story or visual-direction signature without imitating a named creator.

publishing_strategy.cadence: Not selected; choose only after measuring sustainable capacity.

buffer.rationale: Set after scope and cadence are known.

discoverability_deliverables.requirement: Represent as a structured image-generation job after visual gates pass.

collaboration_and_sustainability.capacity_limit: Record the maximum sustainable production load.
collaboration_and_sustainability.rest_policy: Record protected rest and recovery time.
collaboration_and_sustainability.backup_policy: Record versioned local and off-device backup expectations.
efficiency_practices: Reuse approved templates and versioned production references without overwriting prior work.
quality_floor: Reader clarity and continuity do not fall below the approved standard.
scope_reduction_order: Reduce optional promotional scope before weakening story clarity or creator health.

primary_metrics.name: completion readiness
primary_metrics.definition: Approved production units compared with the planned scope.
primary_metrics.interpretation_limit: Completion readiness does not measure reader appeal or commercial success.
